scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => ['dist','dist-electron','release','server.js'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })))"
scripts.electron:preview: npm run build && npm run electron:build:main && node scripts/run-electron.mjs prod
scripts.electron:pack: npm run build && npm run electron:build:main && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run electron:build:main && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis
scripts.dist:win:nsis: npm run build && npm run electron:build:main && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --dir && node scripts/build-win-installer.mjs
